fields.summary_ko.0: Amazon (AMZN) rallied up to 5.6% on Monday, with Phillip Securities analyst Helena Wang upgrading to Buy and raising target price from $320 to $330.
fields.summary_ko.1: Last week's Q3 results showed 2026 capex plan of $22.0 billion and 2027 'meaningful additional spending' outlook caused stock to plunge, but strong AWS and AI demand drove rally.
fields.summary_ko.2: CEO Andy Jassy expressed confidence that AWS and AI investments will generate greater revenue and free cash flow ahead, with stock currently trading at 20x PER near historic lows.
